decisions.reason: Exclusion instructions for the ChatGPT prompt do not change the separate, currently deferred obligation to build a constrained random generator in C#.
The prompt-writing instruction does not change how levels may be segmented for curriculum coverage or slower progression.
Telling the AI what content to exclude does not alter the requirement for a distinct visual object at each level.
The source modifies prompt construction but does not change the required representation-type classification or its supported types.
The prompt exclusion guidance does not change the rule for repeating a question in the spreadsheet for every applicable level.
The source does not modify the required grade coverage for the Toy Factory content.
Adding exclusion instructions to an AI prompt does not change the one-question-specification-per-level requirement.
The source gives general prompt-design guidance and does not change the sorting classification or the permitted number range.
The prompt-writing instruction neither resolves the curriculum ambiguity nor changes the curriculum-alignment requirement.
